releases.body:
## Changes
- Load Effect skills by task relevance instead of a mandatory quota; remove redundant skill routing.
- Consolidate overlapping Effect policies and remove repeated templates and review checklist, reducing automatically injected guidance by 13%.
- Update pattern references to the consolidated rules.
- Add a repository command for comprehensive Effect upgrades.

## Verification
- Formatting, lint, and TypeScript checks pass.
- All 912 tests across 53 test files pass.

Upgrade the bundled Effect baseline to 4.0.0-rc.116 and align skills, patterns, and guidance with the supported APIs.

- Migrate Config/CLI, Socket, Schema, property testing, RPC serialization, PostgreSQL, HTTP, and AI/MCP guidance.
- Include complete upstream changelogs for rc.113–rc.116 and the migration audit.
- Update secret-configuration detector coverage and compile marked documentation examples.

Validation: formatting, lint, TypeScript, and all 912 tests pass.

Fix OpenCode 2.0.8 compatibility: migrate to @opencode/plugin 2.0.8 and register bundled skills with absolute path fields. Resolves the skill.transform failure that disabled the plugin. Verified active in the live server with all 53 skills registered; all 912 existing tests pass.

## Changes

- Upgrade Effect from 4.0.0-rc.111 to 4.0.0-rc.112 and refresh 35 bundled skills, five retained patterns, and two guidance documents.
- Preserve the full upstream release notes, companion-package inventory, and migration audit in the published docs.
- Remove the React VM skill and dedicated VM-file rule; route React state guidance directly to Effect Atom.
- Add compiler checks for 14 marked documentation examples and regression coverage for removed concurrency options.
- Update the bundled catalog to 53 skills, 45 patterns, and four guidance documents.

## Verification

Formatting, lint, TypeScript checks, and all 912 tests pass locally and in push CI.

[Full Effect rc.111 → rc.112 release notes and migration audit](https://github.com/mpsuesser/opencode-effect-enforcer/blob/v0.2.4/docs/effect-4.0.0-rc.112.md)

[Full comparison](https://github.com/mpsuesser/opencode-effect-enforcer/compare/v0.2.3...v0.2.4)

## Changes
- Document the working local checkout configuration using the `src` directory.
- Explain local plugin discovery behavior in OpenCode v0.0.0-beta-19157.
- Add location-scoped plugin activation and status commands.

## Verification
- Formatting, lint, and type checks passed.
- All 916 tests passed across 53 test files.
